cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: CodeFellow combines local compiler and test diagnostics with hint-first programming education in English and natural Kiswahili/English code-switching. It preserves standard coding terms while specializing in correct minimal Python and JavaScript repairs, focused tests, and beginner-friendly offline explanations.

test_prompts.prompt:
A beginner wrote this Python function to return the length of the longest substring without repeated characters:

def longest_unique(text):
    seen = set()
    left = 0
    best = 0
    for right, char in enumerate(text):
        if char in seen:
            seen.remove(text[left])
            left += 1
        seen.add(char)
        best = max(best, right - left + 1)
    return best

It returns the wrong answer for 'abba'. Diagnose the root cause, show the smallest correct patch, write five pytest tests including empty input, all-repeated input, and Unicode input, then explain the sliding-window invariant and time complexity in beginner-friendly language.

Unamfundisha mwanafunzi wa mwaka wa kwanza JavaScript offline. Function yake `function average(values) { return values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value) / values.length; }` inafeli ikiwa array ni empty na numeric strings zinasababisha behaviour isiyotarajiwa. Toa diagnostic hint moja bila solution kamili. Kisha toa robust implementation chini ya `Jibu kamili`, eleza type-coercion issue kwa Kiswahili huku ukihifadhi English coding terms za kawaida, na ongeza runnable tests ukitumia Node `node:test` module.
